# IISc Bengaluru: overview, contacts and student links

The Indian Institute of Science (IISc) is a research institute in Bengaluru. 'IISc in Numbers' on the homepage lists 490 faculty members, 5678 students and 979 courses (current figures: https://www.iisc.ac.in/iisc-in-numbers/).

**Postal address:** The Registrar, Indian Institute of Science, Bangalore 560 012, India.

title: IISc BS (Research) structure, term documents, fees and student support
content:
# IISc BS (Research) structure, term documents, fees and student support

The 4-year **BS (Research)** has a common curriculum in Semesters 1–3 (Physics, Mathematics, Chemistry, Biology, Engineering, Humanities). Semesters 4–8 follow one of five Majors: Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, Biology, or Earth & Environmental Science. Optional Minors: those five plus Materials, Quantum Technology and Bioengineering. The programme ends with a year-long supervised research project.
